# Burning Springs: Head Hunt Bosses - Group 1

With thanks to SpaceLime

*****Subject to change pending porting to live servers*****

Each Head Hunt boss comes with a distinct weapon setup and a signature mechanic, and their side-kick group follows a similar theme. Side-kicks use weapons, attack styles, or status effects that fit the same flavour as the boss they support.

The list below breaks both bosses and their side-kicks into two parts:

**Weapon and Effect**

Covers everything tied directly to their weapon, including any built-in mod effects.

**Unique Attack**

Covers any additional ability they have on top of what the weapon already does.

**The Black Horseman**

**Weapon and Effect**

- “Famine” Gatling Plasma
- Each hit removes 129 hunger points (10.4 percent of the full food bar)

**Unique Attack**

- Deals 2x damage when the player’s food bar is at 16.67% or lower

**Side-kick group: Ravenous Gluttons (Death Gang)**

**Weapon and Effect**

- None

**Unique Attack**

- Standard feral ghoul melee attacks with no extra effects

**The Pale Horseman**

**Weapon and Effect**

• “Death Gun” .50 Cal Machine Gun

• Crippling legendary mod

• Each hit deals 5x damage to players

**Unique Attack**

• None

**Side-kick group: Killer Reapers (Death Gang)**

**Weapon and Effect**

• “Deathbringer” Submachine Gun

• Crippling legendary effect

• Cryo effect that freezes the player on hit

**Unique Attack**

• None

**The Red Rider**

**Weapon and Effect**

- "War" Cremator
- Bloodied Legendary Mod
- Executioner’s Legendary Mod

**Unique Attack**

- Frenzy aura that forces nearby NPCs to become aggressive

**Side-kick group: Brutal Combatants (War Gang)**

**Weapon and Effect**

- Bloodied “The Fixer”
- +20% damage

**Unique Attack**

- None

**The White Horseman**

**Weapon and Effect**

• “Pestilence” Plasma Caster

• Deals 40 radiation damage on hit

• Applies 45 poison damage per second

**Unique Attack**

• Applies 12 poison damage per second to enemies that hit the White Horseman

• Effect only applies when the attacker deals damage

• Leaves a toxic area on death, identical to the Daily Ops Toxic Blood mutation

**Side-kick group: Burning Stingwings (Pestilence Gang)**

**Weapon and Effect**

• None

**Unique Attack**

• Abraxodyne Corrosion on melee hit

• 10 damage per second for 5 seconds

• 2 radiation damage per second for 8 seconds

• Reduces the target’s Damage Resistance by 40 for 20 seconds

• If the target is wearing Power Armor, the DR reduction increases to 60 for 20 seconds
